rules.source_lifetime: _physics_process visits registered alive_list; state handler then _sys_fire_check then queues HP<=0 for death after physical passes. No source health gate in release or charge.
rules.terminal_release: Registered HP<=0 source releases only if its pending attack reaches the normal .8s animation release threshold; fired flag consumes it once; expired/not-yet-due release does not attack.
rules.target_lifetime: _perform_attack checks target registration and node validity, not target HP; attack/pursuit state may clear a dead target earlier. Holding only reacquires when its .1s scan and attack cooldown permit it, otherwise stored target remains.
rules.retaliation: take_damage sets last attacker and eligible idle/move/attack_move pursuit even after lethal damage; does not restore health.
rules.final_charge: Registered charging source receives its current state visit even if an earlier visited actor killed it; collection prevents another visit next step.
